title: Cosmo knows how many tiles a Use Tiles run makes (said ~25, the status bar said 40)
description: Fabio 2026-10-21: during a tile upscale Cosmo guessed ~25 tiles while the status bar showed 40. Its tool text only says 'redraw in 1024 px tiles' (services/agentLoop.mjs:122); the count lives in js/utils/tileCount.js (prompt box label + status bar). Give Cosmo the same number - e.g. in the generate result or describe_model - never a guess. Carry over into MPI-1232 (tile size + dynamic overlap change the count).
